create_uma_finetune_dataset: run the CLI script to create a UMA finetune dataset from ASE atoms directories with energy or force regression tasks
create_yaml_config: create YAML configuration files for UMA model finetuning with dataset paths, normalizer RMSD, and linear reference coefficients
launch_processing: launch parallel processing of ASE atoms object directories to prepare training and validation data for finetuning
compute_normalizer_and_linear_reference: compute the force RMS normalizer and linear reference coefficients from processed training data
run_uma_finetune: run UMA model finetuning using the generated YAML configuration with fairchem -c uma_sm_finetune_template.yaml
